name: libpsl
notes: Added 2026-10-10 for Web Tranche 3B milestone B2: WebKit's curl backend (PublicSuffixStoreCurl, platform/Curl.cmake links LibPSL::LibPSL) needs libpsl >= 0.20.2.

runtime and builtin IDNA use ICU (the CRT icu port, found through its pkg-config files; PKG_CONFIG_LIBDIR is limited to the port prefix so a host ICU is never picked up). The built-in list is generated from list/public_suffix_list.dat in the tarball by libpsl's own tool (python3 on the build host).

LDFLAGS=-Wl,--allow-shlib-undefined: the CRT ICU shared libraries reference the loader-provided __tls_get_addr (global-dynamic TLS in ICU and libc++abi; the accepted loader boundary documented in docs/acceptance/crtweb_acceptance.md), which the link of a configure probe cannot resolve at link time.
